# What ci.yml watches, as git pathspecs -- an exclusion rather than a list,
# because this workflow asks "does the shipped binary still run this
# JavaScript", which everything except prose can change.
#
# Read by that workflow's `changes` job and by `just check-workflow-gates`.
# `:(glob)` stops `*` at a directory separator, which is what makes `*.md`
# mean a top-level Markdown file exactly as GitHub's `paths-ignore` did.
.
:(glob,exclude)docs/**
:(glob,exclude)*.md
:(exclude)LICENSE
